edits.original: -   Initial Rider Attributes: ID (auto-incrementing), location (435, 385), speed (10 units/tick), status (0 = idle).
edits.modified: -   Initial Rider Attributes: ID (auto-incrementing), status (0 = idle).

edits.original: -   Assignment Strategy: Closest rider first (based on Euclidean distance).
-   Picking Up (1) → Delivering (2): Upon arriving at the restaurant's coordinates.
-   Automatically remove completed orders from the rider's order list.
-   Update the rider's status to idle, releasing the resource.
-   Recruitment Cost: 300 per rider (deducted from system funds).
-   Trigger condition: When system funds are ≥ 300 and the number of pending orders exceeds the number of idle riders, a new rider is automatically created
edits.modified: -   Trigger condition: When system funds are ≥ 300, a new rider is automatically created

edits.original: -   Grid Map: An 8x8 grid representing an 800x800 coordinate system. Each 100x100 unit is a grid cell. Points at integer hundreds (e.g., 100, 200) represent restaurant/customer locations, while other points represent roads. Riders are initialized on a road.
edits.modified: -   Grid Map: An 8x8 grid representing an 800x800 coordinate system. Each 100x100 unit is a grid cell.

edits.original: -   Automatic Coordinate Transformation: Converts input coordinates to the center point of the corresponding grid cell.
-   System Funds: 1000 (to support rider recruitment and operational costs)
-   Display of each rider's location, status, and number of assigned orders.
